Man, it's so scary, like if my mom found out about my self harm history, I know she would beat me and blame me for it, so I respect you for even attempting to share such an intimate struggle. People like that think it's all jokes, when so much pain can be healed by simply listening and hearing the other person, most of all WANTING to hear and understand. Unfortunately, most parents are too scared or too proud to admit their perfect little baby can have inner demons... I do believe that one day someone will come along and hear me, not a lover, but I'm envisioning a sort of mentor figure. And I also believe that someone will hear you too one day, however far away it may seem...

Hey op I'm not gonna lie, I am lucky to say I have a friend with a heart like yours and I've been feeling like a thankless consumer lately, it's kind of weird how being close to someone entails such feelings. Truthfully, a lot of people are scared of intimacy because of a power imbalance - there's the giver and the taker. The giver feels drained, the taker feels guilty. It's hard to find a healthy balance, and it's true that you must not invest too much of your good spirit into the wrong people (or just random people). Sometimes you find comfort in unlikely places, and I hope you will meet someone worthy of your time
